name: Omae no Onna o Netotteyaru ~Mukashi Yatta Onna wa Ima wa Hakui no Tenshi. Danna no Mae de Kokoro mo Shintai mo Moteasonde Netoru~
original_name: お前のオンナを寝取ってやる ～昔ヤったオンナは今は白衣の天使。旦那の前で心も身体も弄んで寝取る～
source: Ryuichi was a major rapist that treated his victims as toys, until a sudden change happens to him after he graduated from college. Several years later, he starts to work at a clinic and there recognizes one of his previous victims, Ayaka the wife of his boss. Ryuichi, who since college do not feel anything for women, once more the lust inside him awakens, with intentions of making her, his toy again.
